verdict.rationale: The only remote-trigger evidence says ZCode can be woken remotely via WeChat, Feishu, or Telegram. None of the platforms the story names (GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Slack) is documented as a way to start agent tasks. This is an adjacent integration on different platforms, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack
